title: Claim's live-driver refusal is per-checkout: a second run-epic from another checkout of the same repo is not refused
body: runlife.Claim refuses a second driver only by reading the pidfile in the checkout it runs in, so the same run id started from a second checkout of the same repository starts a second reconciler; the run-state CAS is left as the only defence, which Claim's own doc calls the last line. The machine registration aj9 added names the checkout whose pidfile is live, so Claim could now also refuse a claim when the registered repo's probe answers alive. A test that claims a run in checkout A and asserts Claim from checkout B is refused would demonstrate it.
